assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production transparent PNG material asset for an iPhone app, not a screenshot or UI.
Create one believable premium WOVEN WRISTBAND LOOP, neutral grayscale, isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background. A continuous flexible fabric loop seen in three-quarter front view from a slightly elevated camera: open elliptical center clearly visible, rounded rear strap at top, the broad front strap crossing near the bottom. It must read immediately as a wristband that goes around a wrist, not a flat banner, folded towel, bracelet chain, or circular ring. Object fully visible with about 8% safe margin on all sides. Wide composition approximately 2:1.
Materials: finely woven warm-white/light-gray nylon with precise small interlocking threads, slight stitching along upper and lower fabric edges, realistic darker interior weave and soft occlusion where the loop turns. The front face should have light grayscale values and enough clean broad area for native text placed by the app. NO text is part of the image. Use believable microtexture at high resolution, refined product photography, tactile but not fluffy. Upper-left soft studio key lighting, gentle highlights, natural shading on the object only. Entirely neutral illumination, no colored light. Color will be applied to this neutral image in SwiftUI.
Constraints: ACTUAL transparent background, preserve alpha including the open center, no background, no floor or cast shadow outside the object. No metal hardware, buckle, clasp, label, lettering, symbols, logo, icon, badge, printed graphics, watermark, hand or person. No neon glow. Deliver only the complete single object, clean high-resolution PNG.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production transparent PNG material asset for native iPhone controls, not a UI mockup.
Create one blank premium BRUSHED ALUMINUM SIGNAL PLATE, isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background. Straight-on orthographic front view, level and symmetrical, horizontal rounded rectangle with actual plate width to height approximately 1.65:1. Refined corner radius around 12% of plate height. Fully visible with about 8% transparent safe margin; plate should occupy most of canvas.
Material: real pale neutral silver aluminum, very fine horizontal brushing, smooth precision-machined perimeter, shallow beveled lip and thin bright edge, restrained industrial product render. Subtle physical thickness suggested by lower edge but face stays exactly frontal, no perspective tilt. Even medium-light gray center so native black text and icon can later be drawn legibly by the app. Soft top-left studio illumination, clean metal highlights within the object, restrained reflection. This is an unmarked tangible plate suitable for a luxury event wristband.
Constraints: absolutely blank center. No words, no logo, no icon, no engraving, no screws, no holes, no notch, no buckle, no fabric, no other objects. No cyan/colored glow or neon. No external floor/background or cast shadow beyond object. ACTUAL transparent PNG alpha, not checkerboard printed into image. High-resolution complete single-object material texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium 3D illustrative welcome artwork for a social app, never a screenshot or UI.
Render SIX extraordinary miniature architectural SOCIAL-WORLD DIORAMAS as one cohesive composition arranged precisely TWO COLUMNS BY THREE ROWS, viewed in consistent elevated three-quarter perspective, filling a portrait canvas with tight neat gaps. Entire background is uniform very dark carbon #080A0B. These are lovingly crafted tangible scale models with realistic materials, intricate details and warm practical lighting.
Top left: inviting tiny sidewalk café with striped awning, plants, wooden tables, cups, espresso counter and warm pendants; no sign lettering.
Top right: white-wall art gallery with colorful abstract paintings, a sculptural object on plinth, timber bench and warm spotlights.
Middle left: intimate music studio with piano/keyboard, two guitars, speakers, warm lamp, patterned rug and green plants.
Middle right: small independent venue entrance with tall timber doors, red velvet ropes, restrained red carpet, warm wall sconces and potted greenery; no lettering.
Bottom left: cozy board-game table with tiny colorful unbranded game pieces and cards, curved green chairs, shelves and warm table lamp.
Bottom right: lush garden courtyard with built-in bench, low round central table, layered plants, string lights and lanterns.
Style and materials: sophisticated photoreal miniature craftsmanship, finely detailed wood, linen, leather, brushed metal, ceramic and living foliage. Distinct miniature rooms on thin raised architectural bases, all visually coherent. Vibrant yet tasteful warm amber practical lights, rich green plants, subtle blue and red accents. Warm sociable evening atmosphere against the quiet carbon void. Highest detail and luxury editorial art direction, clear readable little worlds at mobile size, no excessive empty margins. Each of the six dioramas must be fully contained and visually separated enough to read, with no background grids or container frames.
Absolutely no people, hands, animals, text, words, numbers, logos, signs, app chrome, buttons, typography, phone frames, watermarks. Do not add any UI or title. This artwork will sit above real native headings and buttons.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent brushed aluminum material for native iPhone signal buttons.
Edit the provided blank aluminum plate ONLY to correct its proportions: the VISIBLE METAL OBJECT must have width-to-height ratio 1.65:1, substantially TALLER and less elongated than the reference. E.g. a 1320 pixel wide visible object should be 800 pixels tall. Preserve front-on orthographic view, small rounded corners, refined thin machined bevel, horizontal finely brushed natural silver face, existing believable material, blank center, neutral lighting, true transparent background. Center the whole plate with small even transparent margins. No text, labels, symbols, logo, holes, notches, UI or other objects. Preserve alpha outside the plate and fully opaque material inside except naturally antialiased edge. The visible object must be tall enough for icon and two lines of native text. Deliver single clean PNG asset.
